_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-12 (post-V1.1 reconciliation). Live ID: HdJc5cy8cmqMBfGR. 2026-06-12 fix: the live website form's 'Preferred Time' field was still free-text, not matching V1.1's required scheduling UX. Replaced with 'Preferred Date' (date picker) + 'Preferred Time' (30-min dropdown, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM ET, mirroring WF06's Appointment Booking dropdown). 'Normalize Lead' now combines both into a single 'preferredTime' string (e.g. '2026-06-15 9:00 AM') to match the existing single-column Leads schema.
name: Form Capture + Confirmation

parameters.formDescription: Tell us what is going on and we will get right back to you.

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks! Your request is in. We will text or call you shortly to lock in your free inspection.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-haiku-4-5", max_tokens: 300, system: $json.systemPrompt, output_config: { format: { type: "json_schema", schema: $json.schema } }, messages: [ { role: "user", content: $json.userContent } ] }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const lead = $('Parse Confirmation').first().json;
return [{ json: {
  source: lead.source,
  firstName: lead.firstName,
  lastName: lead.lastName,
  phone: lead.phone,
  email: lead.email,
  address: lead.address,
  serviceNeeded: lead.serviceNeeded,
  leadId: lead.leadId,
  logChannel: 'SMS',
  logDirection: 'Outbound',
  logHandler: 'AI (Haiku 4.5)',
  logSummary: 'Sent confirmation SMS',
  logNotes: lead.smsMessage
}}];

parameters.content: This workflow captures website form submissions (form or webhook), upserts the lead into the CRM, sends the customer an AI-written confirmation SMS (Haiku 4.5), logs all communication, and sends an Every Lead Alert (email by default, SMS optional) to the owner for every submission.
